db_host.description: Database server hostname or IP address (ignored for SQLite)

db_name.description: Name of the database to use

db_password.description: Password for the database user (leave empty for SQLite or trust-based auth)

cache_enabled.description: Enable caching of recent history lookups

cache_ttl_seconds.description: How long cached entries remain valid (seconds)

cache_max_size.description: Maximum number of entries in the cache

worker_threads.description: Number of worker threads for background processing

worker_max_tasks.description: Maximum number of concurrent tasks per worker

retention_max_age_days.description: Maximum age (in days) for history entries before automatic deletion

retention_batch_size.description: Number of entries to process per retention cleanup batch

ignore_sources.description: List of event sources to exclude from history storage

filter_min_age_seconds.description: Minimum age (seconds) an event must have before it's processed (prevents out-of-order issues)

log_level.description: Minimum log level to record (debug, info, warning, error)

log_file.description: Path to the service log file

log_max_size_mb.description: Maximum size of each log file before rotation (MB)

log_max_files.description: Number of rotated log files to retain

enable_dedup.description: Enable event deduplication using content hash

enable_remote_sync.description: Enable real-time sync of history entries to a remote service

remote_sync_url.description: URL of the remote sync endpoint (requires enable_remote_sync=true)
